map.两种测产法：① 穗数法按「亩穗数 × 穗粒数 × 千粒重」折算理论产量；② 样方: Two yield methods: (1) the ear-count method converts theoretical yield from "ears per mu x grains per ear x thousand-grain weight"; (2) the quadrat method takes the actual harvested weight of the sample plot, multiplies by the dry matter ratio and scales it to one mu. Both then normalize moisture at the standard 13%: standard yield per mu = yield per mu x (100 - actual moisture) / (100 - 13), so yields at different moisture contents become comparable. Total yield = standard yield per mu x area, and a reference grade for crop yield is given.
map.产量 = 每亩株数 × 单株有效穗/荚/果 × 单穗/荚粒数 × 千粒重 / 1: Yield = plants per mu x effective ears/pods/fruit per plant x grains per ear/pod x thousand-grain weight / 1000 / 1000.
map.估产误差主要来自哪？: Where does the yield estimate error mainly come from?
map.作物产量估算器，按亩穗数、穗粒数、千粒重公式测产，支持多作物与历史产量参考，辅助: The crop yield estimator measures yield from the formula of ears per mu, grains per ear and thousand-grain weight, supports multiple crops and historical yield references, and helps forecast and estimate yields.
map.单株性状（穗粒数、千粒重）的空间变异最大，取样要有代表性；密度误差可通过逐行清点: Per-plant traits (grains per ear, thousand-grain weight) vary the most in space, so the sample must be representative; density error can be reduced by counting row by row.
map.常见。理论产量按『理想单株』算，实际有空秆、秃尖、落粒、病虫折损。乘以保苗率与收: Common. Theoretical yield assumes an "ideal plant", while reality has blank stalks, bare tips, seed drop and pest damage. Multiplying by the stand rate and the harvest index (0.8~0.9) brings it close to the actual yield.
map.按保苗率折算实际可达产量。: Convert to the actually achievable yield using the stand rate.
map.理论产量和实收差很多正常吗？: Is a large gap between theoretical yield and actual harvest normal?
map.用于产前估产与收储计划。: Used for pre-harvest yield forecasts and purchase planning.
map.穗数法 亩产(kg) = 亩穗数(万穗) × 穗粒数 × 千粒重(g) ÷ 1: Ear-count method yield per mu (kg) = ears per mu (10k ears) x grains per ear x thousand-grain weight (g) / 1 000 000; quadrat method yield per mu = sample weight x dry matter ratio x 666.67 / sample area; standard yield per mu = yield per mu x (100 - moisture) / (100 - 13)
map.：密度 4500 株/亩、单株穗数 1、穗粒数 520、千粒重 320 g。理论: : density 4500 plants/mu, 1 ear per plant, 520 grains per ear, thousand-grain weight 320 g. Theoretical yield = 4500x520x320/(1000x1000) = 748.8 kg/mu. With a 90% stand rate and a harvest index of 0.85, the expected actual yield ≈ 748.8x0.9x0.85 ≈ 573 kg/mu.
